# Rocket colour-exactness evidence

`PyFlytRocketLanding.color_exactness_applicability` excuses five lit colour
leaves from literal RGB equality. It cites these two records:

- `colour_law_ceiling.json`: the measured ceiling of bullet3 TinyRenderer's
  multiplicative lighting law (maximum shading factor below 1).
- `colour_check_decision.md`: the decision packet on which the ruling was made.

Both were previously under `tests/fixtures/regression/join/step8/certification/`
and are byte-identical. The Step-7 findings and review sections the declaration
used to cite are at tag `pre-repository-cleanup`, under
`tests/fixtures/regression/join/step7/rocket-landing/`.
